module.purpose: Implements a database collection subscription system that manages real-time change notifications with support for snapshots, filtering, pagination, and truncate event handling.
module.summary: The CollectionSubscription class provides a robust subscription mechanism for database collections, enabling clients to receive filtered change events. It supports initial state loading, optimized snapshots with ordering and limits, cursor-based pagination, and handles complex scenarios like collection truncation with buffered refetching. The class manages sent keys tracking to prevent duplicate deliveries and supports both eager and lazy sync modes.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time data synchronization between database collections and client applications. Critical for collaborative apps where data consistency and change propagation are essential. Failures result in stale data or missed updates for subscribers.
